task_text: Build a small editable specimen-board exporter for our SVG board utility. Board input and editing interaction are undecided.

proposed_scope.summary: A library module (no GUI) with two parts: (1) an editable specimen-board data model — a board holding named specimen entries, each with position, size and a fill attribute, that can be created from a board description and mutated by add/move/restyle operations; (2) an exporter that serializes the board to an SVG fragment (one <rect>/<text> group per specimen) suitable for dropping into the existing SVG board utility's output.
deliverables: validation of board (duplicate specimen names, positions inside board bounds)
a few small unit tests for model round-trip and exporter output

key_decision_question: What is the board input format this exporter must accept, since 'Board input and editing interaction are undecided'?

options.title: Plain JS object / JSON board description as input
options.description: createBoard(JSON.parse(file)) accepts a JSON document: { width, height, specimens: [...] }. Editing is via library calls in scripts/tests, not an interactive UI.
options.tradeoff: Cheapest to build and test, works headless, but no interactive editing — 'editable' means programmatically editable only.
options.shows_it_works: A test writes a JSON file, loads it into the model, mutates it (move one specimen, set a fill), exports SVG, and asserts the exported markup reflects the mutation.
options.grounded_in: Task text only: the directory is empty and the task says 'Board input and editing interaction are undecided.'

options.title: Load input from an existing SVG board document
options.description: The importer reads an SVG file the utility already produces (rect/text shapes), converts it into the editable model, allow edits, then re-export.
options.tradeoff: Round-trips with the current utility's real artifacts, but depends on an SVG dialect I cannot see anywhere in this workspace, so parsing rules would be guesswork.
options.shows_it_works: Given a sample SVG from the existing utility, import-mutate-export round-trip test preserves all unchanged specimens.
options.grounded_in: Task text mentions 'our SVG board utility', implying existing SVG board artifacts exist somewhere; no such file exists in greenfield/ to confirm their shape.

options.title: Interactive editing (CLI prompt or GUI) first
options.description: Build the editing interaction (e.g. a small CLI that lets a user pick a specimen and move/restyle it) before the exporter.
options.tradeoff: Directly addresses the undecided 'editing interaction', but is the largest scope, needs UX decisions a prototype cannot make alone, and delays anything exportable.
options.shows_it_works: A scripted terminal session creates a board, edits two specimens, and exports valid SVG.
options.grounded_in: Task text: 'editable specimen-board exporter ... editing interaction are undecided.'

recommendation: Option A, with B as a follow-up slice once a sample SVG from the real utility is available.
notes: No person has been consulted and nothing here is approved; this is a proposal only. The consequential decision (input format, and whether 'editable' must be interactive) belongs to the requester.
